decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game through removal spells and hand disruption, while also utilizing cards like Eternal Dragon and Exalted Angel for value and win conditions. By efficiently removing threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to establish board control and eventually finish the game with its powerful threats. The combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and strong creatures allows the deck to adapt to different matchups and maintain control over the game's pace. Additionally, the inclusion of utility lands like Dust Bowl and Kor Haven provides further options for resource denial and protection.

This deck aims to control the board with a combination of removal spells like Vindicate and Lightning Bolt, while also utilizing creatures like Merfolk Looter and Meddling Mage to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful threats like Lightning Angel and Mother of Runes to close out the game. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to the deck's diverse range of spells, with a mix of fetch lands, pain lands, and City of Brass. Ultimately, the deck seeks to out value and out maneuver the opponent to victory.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Warchief to quickly get creatures on the board, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Cards like Goblin Ringleader and Goblin Matron help to keep the Goblin train rolling, while Mogg Fanatic and Goblin Piledriver provide additional ways to pressure the opponent. With a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and creature value generators like Siege-Gang Commander, this deck aims to take control of the battlefield early and maintain its advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing powerful control cards and efficiently managing resources, particularly lands. The deck focuses on card advantage and disruption, with a combination of countermagic, removal, and card draw. The goal is to slow down the opponent's game plan, while establishing a solid mana base to play threats like Exalted Angel and Eternal Dragon. By maintaining control of the game through countermagic and removal spells, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantages.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble and protect the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle. By using cards like Vision Charm, Guided Passage, and Portent to dig for the combo pieces, the deck aims to have the Dreadnought enter the battlefield with its drawback stifled, leaving behind a massive 12/12 threat. With additional disruption from cards like Mana Leak and Hidden Gibbons, the deck aims to control the game until it can successfully execute its game-winning combo.

The deck focuses on using Stasis to lock down the opponent's board, while utilizing efficient card draw and countermagic to maintain control. Black Vise serves as a win condition by punishing the opponent for holding too many cards. The deck also includes bounce spells like Chain of Vapor to deal with threats and buy time. Overall, the key strategy is to establish a lock with Stasis and disrupt the opponent's game plan until the win condition can be achieved.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own board presence with creatures like Exalted Angel and Meddling Mage. The inclusion of cards like Powder Keg and Mox Diamond allows for additional control over the battlefield, while cards like Call of the Herd provide a steady stream of creatures. The mana base is designed to support the deck's control elements while also providing access to a variety of colors for its spells.

The deck focuses on using control elements such as counterspells and lockdown effects combined with the Survival of the Fittest engine to consistently search for and utilize powerful creature cards. By leveraging mana dorks and mana-fixing lands, the deck can quickly ramp into its threats like Deranged Hermit, Tradewind Rider, and Masticore. Additionally, the inclusion of Winter Orb helps to further disrupt the opponent's resources, ensuring that the deck can maintain a dominant board state and outvalue the opponent in the long run.

This deck is focused on using the combo of Opalescence and Parallax Wave to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Attunement and Intuition to fill the graveyard with enchantments, the deck can effectively set up for a game-winning Replenish. Decree of Silence can shut down opposing spells, while Abeyance and Seal of Cleansing provide additional control options. With the ability to generate a substantial board presence and control the game through enchantments, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver its opponent to secure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to use cards like Attunement, Intuition, and Frantic Search to fill your graveyard with enchantments. Then, you can use Replenish to bring back all those enchantments at once, overwhelming your opponent with powerful effects like Opalescence and Parallax Wave. Use Decree of Silence to control the board, while Meddling Mage and Seal of Cleansing disrupt your opponent's game plan. With a combination of card draw, control, and explosive combo potential, this deck aims to quickly overpower your opponent and secure victory.

This goblin deck aims to swarm the battlefield with low-cost, efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to bring in more creatures, supported by Goblin Warchief for cost reduction and Goblin Piledriver for massive damage potential. Removal cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Siege-Gang Commander provide control options while maintaining pressure. With a mix of aggression and utility, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and close out the game before they have a chance to recover.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Pyroclasm, Smokestack, and Sphere of Resistance. The deck aims to create a resource advantage with cards like Sylvan Library and Winter's Grasp, while also applying pressure with land destruction spells like Thermokarst. The mana base is designed to support the deck's strategy with a balance of mana acceleration, utility lands, and disruption in the form of Wasteland and Rishadan Port.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate. The deck aims to apply early pressure while also maintaining card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library. With a mix of creature threats and direct damage, this deck is designed to quickly deplete the opponent's life total before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive early plays through utilizing cards with madness and threshold mechanics to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It aims to control the board with counter spells and removal while also having the ability to draw additional cards and generate tokens. The inclusion of Meddling Mage allows for disruption of the opponent's strategy, and Weathered Wayfarer helps to fix mana and find key lands. The ultimate goal is to maintain a strong board presence and finish off the opponent with powerful creatures like Psychatog and Anurid Brushhopper.

The goal of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle, allowing for a powerful and efficient win condition. The deck includes several ways to protect the combo with countermagic and disruption spells, while also providing card selection and manipulation to help find the necessary pieces. By utilizing a mix of efficient spells and powerful combo pieces, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and quickly close out the game with the combo.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw while simultaneously slowing down the opponent's resources with cards like Standstill and Wasteland. It aims to create a board state where the opponent is unable to mount a significant threat while slowly building up its own resources through card advantage and mana denial. The win condition is typically through creature beats or creating a large number of tokens with cards like Decree of Justice.
